individual_mathematical_reason: PlanetMath's four conditions each have a precise logical role. Nonempty and proper exclude endpoints at negative and positive infinity; downward closure fixes the lower-set convention, while having no largest rational selects the unique lower side at each rational boundary. This is different from a Dedekind-complete abstract ordered set.

PlanetMath defines real numbers in this model as the rational cuts themselves and orders distinct cuts by strict inclusion. The non-strict relation is its reflexive extension. The rational embedding via strict lower rays is injection preserving order. The claim that arithmetic and completeness hold is an additional proof obligation, not a substitution for those proofs. The new model is a contextual real-number definition, not literal equality to the abstract axiomatic complete ordered field.
